release_rule: No demolition, concealed-work or procurement release until the applicable entries are surveyed and signed off locally.

entries.required_check: survey balconies, wet cores, slabs, walls and ceilings for ingress, mould, rot, corrosion and substrate failure
entries.release_by: building surveyor or relevant qualified trade

entries.required_check: identify region- and building-age-relevant hazardous materials before disturbance
verify service capacity, earthing/grounding, residual-current protection, circuit separation and wet-area protection
confirm whether gas or combustion appliances exist and verify exhaust, make-up air and carbon-monoxide detection
verify smoke detection, escape route, stair/corridor separation and door-swing obstruction
measure each opening and check swing, clear width, furniture, accessibility, services and adjacent doors
verify water pressure, shut-offs, stacks, drain elevations, traps, ventilation, falls and maintenance access
verify wall, beam, lintel, slab edge, balcony connection, facade module, wind/rain and approval constraints
entries.release_by: architect/structural engineer and applicable authority or property body
